g.text: Tag, unsigned digest or wrong key refused (nothing unpacked)
Signed digest unpacked into the models volume (.model-digest written)
cmd: just kit-init-check | pass: prints 'unsigned-digest: rc=1 unpacked=False', 'tag-not-digest: rc=2' and 'wrong-public-key: rc=1 unpacked=False'
cmd: just kit-init-check | pass: prints 'signed-digest: rc=0 weights_present=True sha256_matches=True model_digest_file=True'
cmd: just kit-init-check | pass: prints 'PASS kit-init' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-cosign-registry; the check volume is removed
cmd: just kit-image-build | pass: podman build exits 0 and the image answers 'pull-kit --help'

cmd: just pod-render-check | pass: prints 'hugging-face mode: ... pull_model_blocks=1', 'kit mode: ... ref_pinned=True key_mounted_ro=True', 'refusals: tag rc=2 missing_key rc=2' then 'PASS pod-render'
